title: Stale Closure Lifecycle Across Renders
description: Trace how a timer registered in Render #1 stays bound to Render #1's lexical environment while Render #2 creates new state.

steps.label: 1. Render #1 Creates Closure (count = 0)
steps.description: useEffect(..., []) registers setInterval. Its callback captures LexicalEnv#1 where count === 0.

steps.label: 2. Render #2 Updates State (count = 1)
steps.description: First tick sets count = 1. Component re-renders with LexicalEnv#2, but the old interval still holds LexicalEnv#1.
steps.codeHighlight: // UI shows 1, but interval callback still sees count === 0

steps.label: 3. Fix: Functional Updater / Ref
steps.description: setCount(c => c + 1) reads the latest queued state inside the runtime instead of the closed-over primitive.
